post.description:
Reconcile Stripe events with local database for the specified lookback period.

This endpoint fetches Stripe events for the specified period and verifies that they have been
properly processed and applied to the local database. It can identify and fix:

- Missing subscription records
- Incorrect plan assignments
- Missing payment/invoice activities
- Orphaned subscription records
- Credit balance mismatches

Args:
    lookback_days: Number of days to look back for events (max 30 due to Stripe API limitations)
    include_processed: Whether to include already processed events (default: False)

Returns:
    Detailed reconciliation report with found issues and fixes applied

Enrich Person Data

This endpoint enriches person data using the People Data Labs (PDL) API.
It takes an email address and optionally a full name, and returns enriched
person information including employment history, education, social profiles, etc.

Args:

Returns:
    PersonEnrichmentResponse: Enriched person data or error information

Enrich Company Data

This endpoint enriches company data using the People Data Labs (PDL) API.
It takes a company name, website, ticker, or profile URL and returns enriched
company information including industry, size, location, social profiles, etc.

Args:
    enrichment_request: Request containing company identifiers

Returns:
    CompanyEnrichmentResponse: Enriched company data or error information

post.description:
Manually retry failed chunks

Can retry specific chunks by ID or all failed chunks.

Features:
- Automatically retries failed and stuck chunks
- Enforces max retry limit (3 custom retries)
- Moves chunks to DLQ after max retries
- Re-downloads original CSV and reprocesses chunks

get.description: Get DLQ entries from batch metadata

post.description:
Retry DLQ entries by reprocessing chunks

This will re-download the original CSV and reprocess the specified chunks.
DLQ chunks are given one final retry opportunity before permanent failure.

Features:
- Removes chunks from DLQ upon retry
- Resets chunk status to allow reprocessing
- Logs all admin actions for audit trail

get.description:

            validity period and any context it may help them to clear this task. Sign the message as 'FastBank'.
